findings.title: Proceeds from Disposals has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Cash Flow from Investing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.

findings.title: Add Credit Impairment & Provisions % of Net Operating Income
findings.detail: Credit Impairment & Provisions has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Credit Impairment & Provisions % of Net Operating Income" = cogs / rev * 100.

findings.title: Gross Interest, Fee & Other Operating Income moved EUR -188M vs Budget
